newsitem.title: CANADA: Eagle Precision to buy Eaton Leonard.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Precision to buy Eaton Leonard.

text.p: Eagle Precision Technologies Inc said on Monday it reached an agreement in principle with Zimmerman Holdings Inc for Eagle to acquire the Eaton Leonard group of companies for about US$12 million to US$16 million.
Eagle Precision said the deal with Los Angeles-based Zimmerman is scheduled to be completed by the end of May.

Eaton Leonard, whose main manufacturing facility is located in Carlsbad, California, had total sales for the year ended February 28, 1997 of about US$36 million, of which about US$27 million was generated from the Carlsbad plant.
Eaton Leonard manufactures sophisticated tube and pipe bending equipment, tube measuring devices and tube bender tooling. Subsidiaries are located in France, Germany and the United Kingdom.

"The businesses of Eagle and Eaton Leonard are complimentary and Eaton Leonard's strong U.S. base of sales strengthens Eagles' position as a world leader in tube forming technology," Eagle Precision President Alex Kepecs said.
